children.value: A vault allows users to securely store their assets. A vault is a fundamental building block in DeFi that, at its core, allows users to securely store their assets (lamports in this case) that only that same user can withdraw later.

In this challenge, we'll build a simple lamport vault that demonstrates how to work with basic accounts, Program Derived Addresses (PDAs), and Cross-Program Invocation (CPI). If you're not familiar with Pinocchio, you should start by reading the
to familiarize with the core concepts that we're going to use in this program.
Before you begin, be sure Rust and Pinocchio are installed. Then in your terminal run:

# create workspace
cargo new Kiloshift_vault --lib --edition 2021
cd Kiloshift_vault
